title: erigeron aucheri
intro: Erigeron aucheri, commonly known as the Aucheri daisy or mountain daisy, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae) and is native to the mountainous regions of Iran, Turkey, and parts of the Middle East. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, contributing to various health benefits such as wound healing, reduced inflammation, and improved digestion. The bioactive constituents of Erigeron aucheri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its analgesic, anti-arthritic, and anti-ulcerative properties. Erigeron aucheri is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various conditions, and its bioactive constituents have been identified as having potential therapeutic benefits in the prevention and treatment of diseases.
